quarterly_data.signal: Following the merger with Calpine in January 2026, Constellation describes itself as the largest private-sector power producer in the world and the largest nuclear energy company in the U.S., with 55 GWs of capacity from nuclear, natural gas, geothermal, hydro, wind and solar facilities. It reports growing demand in 2025 for its Hourly Carbon-Free Energy (CFE) product, having closed several additional Hourly CFE transactions with a strong pipeline of interested prospects.
